## 🐍 Snake Media · Latest updates

### ✨ New & improved
- Check the poster before confirming a movie or show, with a “Wrong title?” option.
- Choose multiple TV seasons, the latest season, or all seasons. New episodes in your selection and future seasons download automatically when a suitable release is available.
- Find movie or TV recommendations by genre, based on your request history.
- Open My requests to see what’s downloading, ready to watch, or nearing expiry. Progress updates stay on your request post where possible.
- Extend a title or keep it permanently from its buttons or your request list. Saved changes now show a confirmation.
- Choose your preferred Jellyfin link: local, Tailscale, or both.
- Check server health, GPU activity, upload speed and storage with /serverstatus.

### 🛠️ Fixes
- Reduced “processing another request” interruptions and fixed stuck-request recovery.
- Improved season selection, button responses and cleanup of expired buttons.
- Improved download-update retries to reduce duplicate messages.

### 📌 Good to know
Menus close after 5 minutes of inactivity; /help opens a fresh one.
Automatic deletion and 24-hour expiry reminders are now live. Movies expire 7 days after import; each TV episode expires after 30 days. Watching can shorten expiry to 7 days. Use Extend or Keep to change it; permanent keeps remain protected.
